verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only interactive tools (API, CLI, MCP server, agent skill) that execute domain/DNS actions when explicitly invoked by a user or agent in real time; there is no documented mechanism for scheduling, triggering, or running unattended background automations (e.g., no webhooks, cron-like jobs, or persistent agent workflows). Auto-renew is a built-in account setting, not an AI-configurable autonomous automation.
